purpose: Rank named missing measurements that would most directly close the current buffering-mechanism coverage gap without privileging Campanula or adding a generic ABM parameter.
ranking_rule: prefer a measurement that discriminates among already-observed buffering explanations
prefer closure of a same-system propagation chain over adding another partial system
prefer source-native or prospective matched measurements over transported values
do not rank by assumed convenience when field/source cost is unknown
Issue #91 is eligible but not privileged

priorities.missing_measurement: controlled reproductive dependency/autonomous assurance in the same focal populations/seasons as the interaction-quality boundary
discriminates: low dependency versus post-interaction resource compensation
priorities.why_high_value: The upstream signed mismatch and interaction-quality change plus high reproductive performance are already observed; one plant-side dependency/assurance layer would directly test why the chain stops before reproduction.
priorities.current_block: raw interaction CSV access is blocked, but a future source-native or prospective controlled dependency measurement can reopen the gate

priorities.missing_measurement: Dong Island standardized single-visit effectiveness plus controlled reproductive dependency
discriminates: low visitation versus low per-visit effectiveness
whether the morph-state/fruit-set contrast is mechanistically bridged on both islands
priorities.why_high_value: Cordia is the current near-complete bridge and already contains all channel types in one source-defined two-island system, but the decisive channels are asymmetric between islands.
priorities.current_block: no qualifying Dong-side source-native values are currently admitted; Yongxing values cannot be transported

priorities.missing_measurement: same-season same-population service/effectiveness, autonomous assurance and reproductive outcome linkage
discriminates: reproductive assurance as current buffer versus establishment filter
current service limitation versus colonization-associated trait filtering
priorities.why_high_value: Nicotiana already shows strong autonomous-assurance differences, but current island service deficit was not detected and the existing bridge spans papers/years.

priorities.missing_measurement: first real linked effective-service plus open/bagged-autonomous/supplemental-outcross field bundle
priorities.why_high_value: The protocol and one-command intake are implementation-ready and the prediction structure is frozen, making this a clean direct calibration route when field rows arrive.
priorities.current_block: real linked field rows are not yet collected/admitted

priorities.missing_measurement: standardized per-visit pollen deposition/effectiveness plus controlled total dependency
discriminates: limited reproductive escape versus service asymmetry
priorities.why_high_value: This would strengthen a propagation case, but the current programme gap is buffering rather than the existence of propagation itself.
priorities.current_block: prospective or new source-native measurements required

claim_boundary: This is a scientific information-value ranking, not a costed fieldwork schedule. Unknown logistical cost, permit feasibility and source accessibility are not imputed.
